description: Speech bubble: a glossy gradient bubble pops out of its tail with a springy overshoot, typing dots first (optional), then the text rises in word by word; pops away on exit. Reactions, what a product would say, comments, voice-of-customer. Transparent.

params.typing: true to show typing dots before the text (default true)
params.background: Solid background used only for opaque .mp4 output
